scripts.build:examples: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @flowsvg/showcase build && pnpm --filter flowsvg-native-example exec vite build && pnpm --filter flowsvg-react-example exec vite build && pnpm --filter flowsvg-vue-example exec vite build
scripts.test:showcase:hosts: pnpm --filter flowsvg-native-example test:showcase && pnpm --filter flowsvg-react-example test:showcase && pnpm --filter flowsvg-vue-example test:showcase
scripts.test:examples: pnpm build:examples && pnpm typecheck:examples && pnpm --filter @flowsvg/showcase test && pnpm test:showcase:hosts && pnpm test:delivery
scripts.test:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm release:verify && pnpm test:examples
scripts.typecheck:examples: pnpm --filter @flowsvg/showcase typecheck && pnpm --filter flowsvg-native-example typecheck && pnpm --filter flowsvg-react-example typecheck && pnpm --filter flowsvg-vue-example typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.showcase.json
